headline: One picture, 2 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 2 different works in 1 village. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 2 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 2 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.013 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 48d90ca90153 on 1 work, a09aeb9c3a24 on 1 work.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (2).
All 2 works report the same GPS point (31.769982, 75.5154407).
All 2 works started and ended on the same day (2026-05-12).
The picture was uploaded 4 times within 48 seconds (2026-05-15 16:00:20 to 2026-05-15 16:01:08).
